searches.reason: Challenge whether strong separation from sampled training negatives translates into discrimination among plausible next choices. Seek false-negative-aware hard-negative objectives for one GRU4Rec network, tested separately from the text intervention. Electronics’ 4.56% sampled wrong-order rate motivates investigation but does not establish the cause of validation errors.
